title: Renew a building practitioner registration
summary: Learn how to renew your building practitioner registration online before it expires.
intro:
When your building practitioner registration is nearing its expiry date you'll receive a renewal notice. You can then renew your registration online before the due date.

### If your registration has expired

You cannot make declarations or lodge regulated designs as a building practitioner in NSW if your registration has expired.

### Change of name or contact details

If you have changed your name or contact details do not start your application until you complete and lodge a Building Commission NSW form for Change of Details – PDF.

### Check your details

To check your registration number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Complete the approved education and training requirements for continuing professional development (CPD) and meet the requirements to maintain your registration.
Meet the requirements to work on regulated buildings.
Hold the required level of insurance cover.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice).
Evidence of your continuing professional development.

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required documents including evidence of your continuing professional development.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to renew your registration.
